source_caption:
CORKED (2026), a tense indie crime story about loss, betrayal, loyalty, and a world where nobody can truly trust each other. Huge respect to @brandtkakulas and @zach_dakis as a first-time directors for creating something this intense on such a small budget especially with cinematography this good.

As someone who mostly watches mainstream productions, I genuinely didn’t expect to finish this and immediately think: I need more of it. The fact that they managed to build this much tension and atmosphere in just 37 minutes makes it even more impressive. Grateful to Brandt Kakulas for the early private screening and full creative freedom on this collaboration.

🎬 CORKED is now streaming on Apple tv and YouTube Movies.
